campaigns.name: Financial Aid (OBBBA)

who.description: Financial aid administrators and directors at career-focused institutions

campaigns.what: Awareness campaign focused on how OBBBA changes affect institutional loan limit determinations and what schools need to know before the effective date.
campaigns.where: Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, outbound email sequences
how: Lead with the compliance angle: schools that miss this will have problems at audit
Position Portico FA as the tool that handles the new complexity automatically
Use Live OBBBA Q&A webinar as a conversion point for warm leads

campaigns.name: Clinical Management (Trajecsys)

who.description: Program directors and clinical coordinators at allied health and nursing programs

campaigns.what: Brand awareness and lead generation for Trajecsys clinical management, targeting accreditation-driven programs during conference season.
campaigns.where: ACEN and ASRT conference presence, targeted outbound sequences
how: Lead with accreditation outcomes: documentation compliance reduces audit risk
Leverage Trajecsys brand equity among clinical programs
Tie The Commons content (case studies, articles) to demo requests

campaigns.name: Attendance

who.description: Campus directors and administrators at career schools focused on student retention and outcomes

campaigns.what: Brand awareness for Portico Attendance and Skills tracking, positioning it as the answer to retention and externship tracking challenges.
how: Frame attendance technology as a student outcomes issue, not an administrative one
Connect to externship and skills tracking as a unified value prop
Drive to The Commons content as a warm-up before outreach
